note: A single site on the hillside above West Hicks Run Road, 5.0 miles past the East/West Hicks fork (7.2 miles from PA 555 at Hicks Run); the booking page calls it full sun. The driveway is dirt, about 300 ft long and listed as a moderate grade: elevation data puts the pad some 9 to 10 m above the road, about 10% on average, so it is a dry-weather driveway and worth walking first. The agency's campsite map layer marks the site as having no trailer access, while the booking page sells it as an RV and trailer site. The road in is a gentle valley-bottom forest road (no more than 3% over any 1.2 km), dirt or gravel. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 017 Middle still listed and bookable online (open in all three windows), Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 25 ft, overhead clearance 20 ft. Dirt driveway 300 ft graded Moderate; 3DEP puts the pin 9-10 m above the road within 50-100 m, about 10% mean: flagged as a ruling-2 edge case (dirt, not gravel or grass). Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; season written (April to end of rifle deer season); facilities written as none. Imagery (leaf-off) does not resolve a pad or driveway at the pin: an even wooded slope with a small bare patch 10 m north. Access road gentle (3.2% max over 1.2 km). NHD: West Branch Hicks Run 112 m, below the road; not waterfront.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (owner decision, ruling 2 does not name this case) - DIRT driveway graded 'Moderate', 300 ft: 3DEP samples put the road 8.8 m below the pin at 52 m away and 10.2 m below at 97 m away, and a 20-m grid shows the pin on an even ~25% hillside with no bench resolved (10-m DEM). A 300-ft (91 m) driveway therefore climbs about 9-10 m, roughly 10% mean. The ruling keeps Moderate GRAVEL and takes out steep GRASS at ~8%+; dirt at ~10% sits between them and behaves like grass when wet. Left in the entry with the grade in the note. This is a single-site entry: if dirt is treated as grass, the entry has no site left.

DCNR GIS layer vs booking page (ruling 5, kept, both in the note): the GIS record for this site says TrailerAccess 'No'; the booking page lists 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' and a 25-ft maximum vehicle length. GIS also: NumberVehicles 1, GroupCamping Yes, 'No equestrian camping'; record edited 2024-05-24.

Imagery could not confirm the pad: Esri leaf-off tiles show a uniform wooded slope at the pin, no 120 x 75 ft 'full sun' opening and no visible driveway. The RA point and the GIS point agree within 9 m, so the pin was not moved; its position on the pad is unconfirmed.

Season written (entry had none): opens 04-01, closes 12-12, from the site page's own statement ('open from the beginning of April through the end of rifle deer season') and 'Status: Open through Sat Dec 12 2026'. The engine's calendar is a little wider at the front: it shows nights Available from early March 2027 (Not Available through 5 March, Available on 11 March; 6-10 March not probed). I wrote the agency's stated April opening; a March night the engine sells is outside the stated season.

Access road: PA 555 (paved) > Hicks Run Road 2.2 mi > West Hicks Run Road 5.0 mi (OSRM 5.07). Steepest sustained 3DEP grade 3.2% over 1.2 km, 5.4% over 400 m (that one on PA 555): far under the Spade Road yardstick. Surface not confirmed (page: 'state forest dirt or gravel roads').
Waterfront: stays not waterfront. NHD: West Branch Hicks Run 112 m away and about 20 m lower, across the road (page: 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Less than 1/4 mile').
